tools.name: list_templates
tools.title: List certificate templates
tools.description: List the certificate designs in your certera account that certificates can be issued from, most recently updated first. Use a template's id with issue_certificates.

tools.name: create_template
tools.title: Create a certificate template
tools.description: Save a finished certificate design as a template in your certera account, so signed certificates can be issued from it. Pass the design as static HTML plus CSS. Write {{recipient_name}} exactly where each recipient's name should appear. Scripts, forms, iframes and event handlers are refused; link images by https URL and load fonts with @import in the css. Design for an A4 page (about 800px wide landscape, 620px wide portrait).

title.description: A name for the template, e.g. "Leadership Programme certificate".

html.description: The certificate markup (body content only), with {{recipient_name}} where the name goes.

css.description: The stylesheet for the markup, as plain CSS.

institution_name.description: The issuing organisation, shown next to the certificate. Can also be given when issuing.

tools.name: issue_certificates
tools.title: Issue signed certificates
tools.description: Issue one signed certificate per recipient from a template in your certera account. Each certificate is recorded on Hedera and gets a public link that anyone can verify. This is real and cannot be undone: confirm the template and the exact list of names with the person before calling. Up to 20 recipients per call; an account can issue 200 per day.

template_id.description: The template to issue from (see list_templates or create_template).

recipient_names.description: Full names, one certificate each, exactly as they should be printed.

institution_name.description: The issuing organisation. Leave out to use the template's.

reference.description: A reference for this batch, e.g. a course run. Repeating a call with the same reference never issues a recipient twice.

tools.name: list_signed_diplomas
tools.title: List signed diplomas
tools.description: List diplomas you have signed on Hedera, newest first, with verification links.

tools.name: list_design_sessions
tools.title: List design sessions
tools.description: List your diploma design sessions in the studio, most recently updated first.
